# opsramp_client (Resource)

Manages an OpsRamp Client (sub-tenant) resource.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the client.

### Optional

- `addons` (Set of String) List of addons enabled in the Client.
- `address` (String) The address of the client.
- `city` (String) The city of the client.
- `country` (String) The country of the client.
- `ext_org_id` (String) External organization ID for the client.
- `packages` (Set of String) List of packages enabled in the Client.
- `phone_number` (String) The phone number of the client.
- `state` (String) The state of the client.
- `time_zone` (String) The time zone of the client.
- `unique_id` (String) A unique identifier for the client.
- `zip` (String) The zip code of the client.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) The unique identifier of the client.

## Example Usage
```terraform
resource "opsramp_client" "example_client" {
  name      = "Example Client"
  address   = "Valencia, Spain"
  country   = "Spain"
  time_zone    = "Europe/Paris"

  addons = [
    "Adapter Integrations",
    "Extended Data Retention",
    "Knowledgebase Management",
    "OS Service Start/Stop Actions",
    "Offline Alerts",
    "Process Automation",
    "Remote Access Management",
    "SMS and Voice",
    "Alert Problem Area"
  ]

  packages = [
    "Hybrid Discovery and Monitoring",
    "Event and Incident Management",
    "Remediation and Automation"
  ]
}
```
